source.source_text: Purpose: atomically create/replace one authorized file with path/type/size policy and optional expected hash. Input: path:string, content:string, encoding?:utf8|base64, expected_sha256?:string, create_only?:boolean. Output: normalized path, bytes, new sha256 and verification. Contract: L2 writes_local; scope mac.files.write; target path; timeout 30000ms; cap 1MiB; network none; filesystem write_allowed_roots; secret zones denied; approval trusted_write; retry safety requires create_only/expected hash. Phase 3 planned.
